Saved .somnet for online recognition.

mechanism: OptVal = max(0,atan(Sw))*(max(0,atan(Br)))*(max(0,atan(Rg))) where SwitchesRaw=#flat+#trend (min~100), BrRaw=min(avg flat bars, avg trend bars) (min~3), RangesRaw=(avg trend HL)/(avg flat HL) (min~1). Soft atan floors equalize criteria and kill pathological 1-bar flats.
data_needed: Per-pass Flat/Trnd Num, Bars, RangHL from the segmenter; SwMin/BrMin/RgMin and coeffs.
